limitations: No Digital Macaroni hands-on import, email connection, pipeline, automation, mobile, export, billing, or support test was completed.
Community feedback is much smaller than the independent review-platform sample.
Automatic contact and activity capture must be checked against a real mailbox before purchase.

claims.statement: Salesflare connects with Gmail, Outlook, calendars, mobile devices, and LinkedIn-assisted workflows to collect contact and activity data.
Automatic data capture, ease of use, email integration, and responsive support are the strongest positive patterns.
Reporting and extensive customization are less suitable for teams with complex CRM requirements.
Growth costs $29 per user per month billed annually or $39 monthly; Pro costs $49 annually or $64 monthly; Enterprise costs $99 annually or $124 monthly.
Growth includes five lead credits monthly, Pro 100, and Enterprise 250. Extra credits can be purchased.
Salesflare prorates added users and applies credit for disabled users to future invoices.

scoreRationale.onboarding: The product is designed to reduce initial and ongoing data entry, but its value depends on a clean email connection, correct contact matching, and a usable import.
scoreRationale.product: A focused CRM for small B2B sales teams that mainly work from email; less suitable for deep reporting, unusual processes, or extensive customization.
scoreRationale.support: Responsive human support is a recurring positive pattern, although no request was tested.
scoreRationale.billing: Per-user prices and the three plan levels are clear; Pro is required for sequences, permissions, and custom dashboards.
scoreRationale.overall: Use one real lead to test automatic capture, team handoff, reminders, reporting, mobile work, duplicates, permissions, and export before moving the full pipeline.

conflictsAndUnknowns: Automatic data capture can save work and can also attach an activity to the wrong person or leave important context out.
A simple CRM is easier for a small team and may be too rigid when the sales process grows.
Email tracking can help with timing and can create privacy, consent, and deliverability concerns.
No hands-on test confirmed import quality, duplicate handling, mobile behavior, reporting, export, or support.
